newsitem.title: CHINA: HK red-chip index derivatives to start on Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: HK red-chip index derivatives to start on Sept 12.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange said on Wednesday it will introduce futures and options contracts on the Hang Seng China-Affiliated Corporations Index for red chips on September 12.
The contracts will be electronically traded on the Futures Exchange's automated trading system, chief executive officer Ivers Riley told a news conference.
About 40 percent of exchange members were on the electronic system, Riley said, adding he was confident the number would soon rise to more than 50 percent.
The margin for the red-chip index futures and options contracts would be higher than for Hang Seng Index futures in percentage terms because of higher volatility, he said.
Hang Seng Index futures are now trading at a margin of HK$50,000 per contract.
The red chip index, monitoring the movement of shares in 32 Hong Kong-listed companies with Chinese financial backing, was launched on June 16.
